name: Co-design attention and KV-cache layout
source_model_term: FlashAttention, QK normalization/rope and KV reshape/cache
hypothesis: Avoid layout conversion and cache-update launches by emitting Q/K/V directly in the decode attention consumer layout.
derivation: The expanded graph records about 0.221 ms/step for FlashAttention, 0.027 ms for cache reshape/update and 0.026 ms for fused QK normalization/rope; the ceiling targets only layout and boundary overhead.

evidence.claim: GPU-active attention, QK transform and KV update contributions.
